description: Desktop-only capability set for the main SecuraCV Lab window. Intentionally EMPTY: the self-update flow (manifest check, native confirm dialog, relaunch) is driven entirely from Rust (self_update.rs), which the webview capability system does not gate, and the Lab frontend never calls plugin:updater, plugin:dialog or plugin:process — it uses core.invoke, event and opener only (see default.json). Granting those three here only widened what an injected script could do. Kept as a file so the desktop/iOS platform split stays visible.
